high_priority.title: Visual Portfolio Gallery
high_priority.description: Create a stunning gallery showcasing before/after, close-ups, and customer moments with your bouquets
high_priority.why: Pesona Florist uses generic placeholder images. Diff with real photos = higher conversion
high_priority.implementation: Add /portfolio or /gallery page with lightbox viewer for Canva + Instagram photos

high_priority.title: Interactive Customization Interface
high_priority.description: Allow customers to mix & match flowers, colors, and add-ons before ordering
high_priority.why: El Bouket seems flexible with custom requests based on Canva data. Formalize this UI.
high_priority.implementation: Build a 3-step configurator: Choose Base → Select Flowers → Add Extras → Order

high_priority.title: Customer Testimonials & Real Photos
high_priority.description: Dedicate section for customer reviews with star ratings and their event photos
high_priority.why: Social proof is critical for UMKM. Pesona Florist lacks this completely.
high_priority.implementation: /testimonials page with Instagram feed integration (real customer posts via hashtag)

high_priority.title: Category Expansion & Better Naming
high_priority.description: Based on Canva data: Chocolate Bouquet, Snack Bouquet, Fresh Flower, Money Bouquet, Satin Bouquet, Vase Arrangements
high_priority.why: Your Canva site shows more variety than typical florist. Emphasize this!
high_priority.implementation: Add category cards with icons + sample images from your Canva downloads

medium_priority.title: Search & Filter System
medium_priority.description: Add filters: By Price, By Occasion (Birthday/Wedding/Corporate), By Budget
medium_priority.why: Pesona has 67 items. When you grow to 100+, search becomes essential.
medium_priority.implementation: React component with Algolia or local filtering

medium_priority.title: Occasion-Based Guides
medium_priority.description: Blog/guides on 'What bouquet for your Birthday', 'Corporate Gift Ideas', etc.
medium_priority.why: Educational content + SEO benefit. Drives organic traffic.

medium_priority.title: Seasonal Collections
medium_priority.description: Highlight seasonal themes: Valentine, Graduation, Wedding Season, Christmas
medium_priority.why: Pesona doesn't emphasize seasonality. You can own this angle.
medium_priority.implementation: Add seasonal banners + dedicated collection pages

medium_priority.title: Video Showcase Section
medium_priority.description: Process videos: From raw flowers → final bouquet, Tips & Tricks, Customer Unboxing
medium_priority.why: Pesona has this. It's proven to increase trust and engagement.

low_priority.title: Referral Program
low_priority.why: UMKM growth hacks. Word-of-mouth is your best channel.
low_priority.implementation: /refer page + referral code in WhatsApp template

low_priority.title: FAQ Section
low_priority.description: Common questions: Delivery radius, Same-day order, Customization, Returns

low_priority.title: Email Newsletter Signup
low_priority.description: Collect emails for new product announcements
low_priority.why: Build owned audience for future promotions
